text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how old you are and when the fever and leg pain started? Have you noticed any bleeding from your gums or nose, or any enlarged lymph nodes in your neck or armpits?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
